allapotsor.index_diagnosztika: The search index has a problem. Open diagnostics.
beallitasok.hiba_javitas: Check that Manifold is still running, then reload the settings. Your notes are not affected.
egeszseg.javitas.zar_takarit: Sets the leftover lock file aside (renamed, not deleted). The AI engine creates a new one when it starts.
egeszseg.javitas.git_zar_takarit: Sets the leftover snapshot lock aside (renamed, not deleted), only if it is old and nothing is saving. Snapshots work again right away.
egeszseg.javitas.regiszter_takarit: Saves a copy of your workspace list, then forgets the entries whose folders no longer exist. No notes or folders are touched, and the saved copy can be restored.
egeszseg.javitas.index_ujraepit: Sets the damaged search index aside (kept as a copy) and rebuilds it from your notes. Search may be incomplete for a moment.
egeszseg.javitas.gyorsitotar_torles: Clears the cache of resized images. It rebuilds itself when needed. Your notes and attachments are not touched.
egeszseg.kezi.index: Close and reopen the workspace. If this keeps happening, open diagnostics and check that the disk is not full.
egeszseg.kezi.pillanatkep: Install Apple's Command Line Tools (run xcode-select --install in Terminal), then reopen Manifold.
egeszseg.kezi.zarak: Wait for the running task to finish, then check again.
egeszseg.kezi.lemezhely: Free up disk space by removing files you no longer need, or move the workspace to a larger drive.
egeszseg.kezi.modellek: Open Settings, then AI and Models, to repair or reinstall the model.
egeszseg.kezi.munkater: Reconnect the drive that holds the workspace, or reopen the workspace from the launcher. Do not move the folder while Manifold is running.
egeszseg.kezi.folyamatok: Quit and reopen Manifold. If another program is using the same network port, quit that program first.
egeszseg.leiras: These checks only read your data. A fix runs only when you choose it, and every fix can be undone or rebuilds itself.
egeszseg.nem_elerheto_javitas: Check that Manifold is still running, then try again.
egeszseg.nincs_reszlet: No further details for this check.
egeszseg.reszlet.workspace_szabad_gb: Free space on the workspace drive (GB)
egeszseg.reszlet.app_data_szabad_gb: Free space on the app data drive (GB)
egeszseg.tudj.altalanos: This check reads the state of your Manifold installation and reports anything unusual.
egeszseg.tudj.index: The search index is a fast lookup built from your notes. It is never the only copy of anything: if it is damaged, Manifold rebuilds it from your Markdown files.
egeszseg.tudj.pillanatkep: Before each change Manifold stores a snapshot so you can undo it. Snapshots live in a separate safety store next to your notes. A leftover lock from an interrupted save blocks new snapshots until it is set aside.
egeszseg.tudj.zarak: Locks prevent two parts of Manifold from using the AI engine at once. If the engine crashes it can leave a lock file behind, which is safe to set aside once nothing is using it.
egeszseg.tudj.lemezhely: Snapshots, backups and the search index grow over time. When the disk is nearly full, saving can fail, so Manifold warns you early.
egeszseg.tudj.modellek: AI models are optional and are downloaded only when you ask. Installed models are checked against the exact version Manifold was tested with.
egeszseg.tudj.munkater: The workspace is the folder that holds your notes. Manifold keeps a small settings file in it and a list of known workspaces on this Mac. External drives must be connected to open their workspace.
egeszseg.tudj.folyamatok: Manifold runs a small background service on this Mac. It starts the AI engine only when a feature needs it.
egeszseg.ures_leiras: Run the checks again to see the state of your workspace.
fejleszto.diagnosztika.leiras: The raw health report, exactly as the app receives it.
fejleszto.git.leiras: Snapshots are stored in git repositories outside your notes.
fejleszto.homokozo.halozat: The sandbox has no network and can only write inside its own temporary folder.
fejleszto.homokozo.leiras: Code and math checks run in an isolated sandbox with strict time and memory limits.
fejleszto.kapcsolo_leiras: Shows technical views: raw diagnostics, build details and measurement commands. Turn it off for everyday use.
fejleszto.kenyszer: Turned on for this session from the launcher. Your saved setting is unchanged.
fejleszto.modell.leiras: Model files found on this Mac.
fejleszto.naplok.leiras: Logs of background tasks. Each task keeps its own log, which you can open from the task panel.
fejleszto.teszt.leiras: Run the test suites from a terminal in the source checkout:
feladat.hiba_javitas: Open the task log below for details, then start the task again. Check History if you want to review or undo changes.
rendszer.hiba_javitas: Check that Manifold is still running, then try again.
rendszer.motor_all: the AI engine starts when needed
egeszseg.tudj.telepites: When Manifold is built, it records a checksum for every file in the app. This check compares the installed app with that record, so a damaged or partly replaced installation is noticed. It never reads your notes.
egeszseg.kezi.telepites: Download Manifold again and replace the app in your Applications folder. Your workspaces and settings are kept outside the app and are not affected.
